/**
 * ====================================================================
 * PHOTO COLLECTION: THE GOOD STUFF (20 Frames)
 * ====================================================================
 * Casual, playful, warm, and real captions & tap stories.
 * Feels like a friend talking about great memories.
 */

export const memories = [
  {
    id: 1,
    image: "/images/photo1.jpg",
    caption: "Okay, this one is actually good.",
    story: "No filter, no complicated planning, just good vibes.",
    tag: "Classic",
    date: "Good times",
    rotation: -2.2,
    yOffset: -8,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "4/5",

    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 2,

    caption: "We look suspiciously normal here.",
    story: "Right after this photo was taken, absolute chaos probably ensued. 😂",

    date: "Archive",
    rotation: 1.8,

    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "3/4",

    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    image: "/images/photo3.jpg",

  {

    caption: "Still one of my favorites.",

    rotation: -2.8,
    yOffset: -10,
    scale: 1.03,
    aspect: "3/4",

  },
  {
    id: 6,
    image: "/images/photo6.jpg",

    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 7,
    image: "/images/photo7.jpg",
    caption: "Yep. Had to include this one.",
    story: "You know exactly what was happening behind the scenes here. 👀",
    tag: "You Know",
    date: "Behind The Scenes",
    rotation: -1.9,
    yOffset: -7,
    scale: 1.01,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 8,
    image: "/images/photo8.jpg",
    caption: "We really thought we were cool. 😂",
    story: "And honestly? Looking back at this, we kind of were.",
    tag: "Peak",
    date: "Cool Kids",
    rotation: 2.1,
    yOffset: 9,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "280px",

  },
  {
    id: 9,

    caption: "Caught completely off guard.",
    story: "The best candids are always the ones where nobody was ready.",
    tag: "Candid",
    date: "Real Moment",
    rotation: -2.4,
    yOffset: -9,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 10,
    image: "/images/photo10.jpg",
    caption: "Pure main character energy. ✨",
    story: "You were definitely feeling that outfit that day, and honestly fair enough.",
    tag: "Iconic",
    date: "Main Character",
    rotation: 1.7,
    yOffset: 7,
    scale: 0.99,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 11,
    image: "/images/photo11.jpg",
    caption: "Golden hour doing all the work. 🌅",
    story: "A really great photo from a genuinely great afternoon.",
    tag: "Sunset",
    date: "Warm Vibes",

    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 12,
    image: "/images/photo12.jpg",
    caption: "Look at that smile. 😌",
    story: "Living proof that good days and good moods exist.",

  {

    image: "/images/photo13.jpg",
    caption: "Another certified classic.",
    story: "Found this in the photo library and immediately saved it for this.",
    tag: "Vault",
    date: "Found It",
    rotation: -2.5,
    yOffset: -11,
    scale: 1.03,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "285px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 14,
    image: "/images/photo14.jpg",
    caption: "Time flies way too fast honestly.",
    story: "Feels like this was just yesterday, but here we are.",
    tag: "Flashback",
    date: "Way Back",
    rotation: 1.9,
    yOffset: 8,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 15,
    image: "/images/photo15.jpg",
    caption: "I remember this like it was yesterday.",
    story: "One of those random days that turned out to be completely unforgettable.",
    tag: "Unplanned",
    date: "Good Memory",
    rotation: -1.6,
    yOffset: -5,
    scale: 1.01,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 16,
    image: "/images/photo16.jpg",
    caption: "Effortlessly cool per usual.",
    story: "Don't let that compliment go to your head though. 😂",
    tag: "Effortless",
    date: "Cool Vibes",
    rotation: 2.3,
    yOffset: 11,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 17,
    image: "/images/photo17.jpg",
    caption: "Definitely a 10/10 day.",
    story: "We need more days like this on the calendar this year.",
    tag: "Top Tier",
    date: "Perfect Day",
    rotation: -2.3,
    yOffset: -8,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 18,
    image: "/images/photo18.jpg",
    caption: "Makes me laugh every single time.",
    story: "Nobody can look at this photo with a straight face.",
    tag: "Hilarious",
    date: "Can't Even",
    rotation: 1.8,
    yOffset: 9,
    scale: 0.99,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "275px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 19,
    image: "/images/photo19.jpg",
    caption: "Photographer deserves some credit. 👀",
    story: "Captured the lighting and the moment perfectly if I do say so myself.",
    tag: "Aesthetic",
    date: "Nailed It",
    rotation: -1.8,
    yOffset: -7,
    scale: 1.01,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 20,
    image: "/images/photo20.jpg",
    caption: "And finally, this classic.",
    story: "Here's to making a hundred more memories just like this one.",
    tag: "The Finale",
    date: "Cheers",
    rotation: 2.5,
    yOffset: 12,
    scale: 0.98,
    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
];
